doc.name: G — 30s music release teaser set in a rainforest, hopeful in tone, a pair of rivals, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: music release teaser set in a rainforest, hopeful in tone
Hero: a pair of rivals
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the music release teaser set in a rainforest, hopeful in tone form, built around a pair of rivals.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Any on-screen text must use the same wording and placement logic in every act.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant in Act 1 against a top-down descent onto a flat plane in Act 3 — while holding the a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second music release teaser set in a rainforest, hopeful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll, shot on a 180mm long macro at f/1.8, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer; grade as Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second music release teaser set in a rainforest, hopeful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a handheld follow with visible micro-shake and breathing correction, shot on a 180mm long macro at f/2, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth; grade as a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second music release teaser set in a rainforest, hopeful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a top-down descent onto a flat plane, shot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/2.8, framed with diagonal dynamic balance across the frame.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with underlighting from a translucent base panel; grade as a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows
